I am an Applied Mathematics Honors student at the Illinois Institute of
Technology pursuing a minor in Computer Science. My interests include graph
theory, differential equations, mathematical biology, pattern formation, and
computational modeling.


## Current Research

### Butterfly Wing Pattern Formation

I am exploring mathematical models of butterfly wing development using image processing, graph representations, and reaction–diffusion systems.

[Explore →](butterfly-wings.qmd)

### Collaboration Networks

I am studying how nonlinear preferential attachment can produce structural inequality in evolving collaboration networks.

[Explore →](collaboration-networks.qmd)
